name: StarPromptDialog
description: One-time nudge asking a repeat user to star the project on GitHub.
notes: Figma is not linked yet. Bespoke night-sky illustration (scoped <style>: twinkling stars + CSS shooting stars, adapted from constgenius/ShootingStar) so it uses raw decorative colours rather than design tokens; the surface is intentionally dark regardless of theme. The action buttons' colour treatment (muted 'Maybe later' text, primary button glow) is part of the same exception and lives in the scoped style block under stable class names. Auto-opens from app state (launch count, seen flag) via bindings, gated behind the What's New dialog; renders closed in Storybook where those stores are inert.
